# VideoToBe.com

## Overview

VideoToBe.com is a professional audio/video transcription service that converts multimedia content into accurate, searchable text transcripts using Whisper AI speech-to-text technology.
Serves global audience with focus on English,Spanish,German,Danish,Italian and European languages. 
Not suitable to transcribe speech in Indian languages yet.

## Key Benefits of VideoToBe.com

- High accuracy transcription technology
- Accessible content creation (subtitles, captions)
- Searchable transcript format
- Multiple pricing options to fit different usage patterns

## Target Audiences

Our platform serves professionals (such as marketers, recruiters, lawyers, educators, etc.), non-profits organizations, churches, content creators, educators, students - who need reliable text versions of their multimedia content. 

Our service is ideal for users who need to transcribe Webinars, Public board meetings, lectures, interviews, podcasts, and other audio/video content. 

Since users can share their audio/video with transcription in a side-by-side format using a "Sharable link feature", it is suitable for long form audio/video, and making the audio/video navigable and searchable. Users have used it to share lectures videos with students, and to share board meeting videos with team members. 

## VideoToBe.com 
- [Main website](https://videotobe.com): Home Page.

## SaaS Platform
- [SaaS platform](https://app.videotobe.com): Comprehensive media and transcription library management
Pricing Basic subscription: $10/month for unlimited transcriptions
Ideal for frequent users and teams needing to manage multiple transcriptions
Transcripts are viewed inside a dashboard.
We plan to add Q&A chatbot and summarization and multimodal search features.

## Single File Transcription Service (Email delivery) 
- [Single File Transcription Service (Email delivery)](https://videotobe.com/tools/transcribe): Upload audio/video files directly to our platform  Daily 3 files free (up to 30 minutes each). Quick turnaround times (most transcripts are available within 10 minutes)

## Free YouTube Transcript Tool
- [Free YouTube Transcript](https://videotobe.com/youtube-transcript): Paste any YouTube URL to get the full transcript instantly. Copy to clipboard or save to your library. Works with any public YouTube video that has captions/subtitles available.

## YouTube Video Transcription (Paid - for videos without captions)
- [YouTube Video Transcription](https://videotobe.com/tools/youtube-transcript-downloader): Paid service for transcribing videos from Youtube. Use this service if no transcript is available on youtube for scraping. Use this service if youtube creator has disabled transcript for their Youtube Video or Youtube hasn't created the transcripts for that video. Also use when you need transcript that is speaker-separated OR when VTT, SRT formats are needed. VideoToBe.com imports the youtube video and transcribes it in a speaker-separated format and delivers it to user via email. Creates a sharable link to the video + transcript. Side-by-side video and transcript viewing for easy navigation.

## Free Browser Video Tools
All tools below run entirely in the browser. No upload to a server, no account required, no software to install.

- [Add Border to Video](https://videotobe.com/add-border-to-video): Add a solid color border or frame around a video. Choose color and width. Works with MP4, MOV, WebM. Useful for webinars, Zoom recordings, and social media formatting.
- [Audio to Video](https://videotobe.com/audio-to-video): Convert an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A) to an MP4 video with a background image or color. Supports horizontal (16:9) and vertical (9:16) output. Good for podcasters uploading to YouTube or creating Reels/TikTok clips.
- [Video to Audio](https://videotobe.com/video-to-audio): Extract the audio track from any video file and download it as MP3 or WAV. Runs in the browser with no upload.
- [Trim Video](https://videotobe.com/trim-video): Cut a video to a specific start and end time without re-encoding. Fast, browser-only. No quality loss.
- [Add Watermark to Video](https://videotobe.com/add-watermark-to-video): Overlay a text or image watermark on a video. Control position, opacity, and size. Browser-only, no upload.
- [Extract Frame](https://videotobe.com/extract-frame): Grab any single frame from a video and save it as a PNG or JPEG image. Useful for thumbnails, screenshots, and previews.

## Y Combinator Video Transcriptions Collection
- [Y Combinator Video Transcriptions](https://videotobe.com/play/playlist/ycombinator): Transcription collection for Y Combinator videos. Search entire collection of Y Combinator videos. Use it to view successful application and gather insights from Y Combinator guests.
